Bulk Subject Entry via Excel

Template columns: Class, Subject, Periods Per Week. The Class value must exactly match a class generated from Page 02 student records. Any row with a class that is not found, or a subject already configured for that class, is skipped and reported after upload.

Class / Division Management & Class Teacher

Student records entered on Page 02 are automatically grouped by class and divided according to the configured Kerala Government student-strength rules. After subjects are configured, only the teachers responsible for subjects assigned to the selected class are offered as Class Teacher candidates.

Auto from Page 02 Students
Classes I–V use 30 students per teacher/division; Classes VI–VIII use 35 students per teacher/division; Classes IX–X use the KER Rule 23 limit of 45, with excess admission up to 50 and a new division beyond 50.
Division counts refresh automatically whenever student records are added, edited, imported or deleted on Page 02.
Automatic selection: the system chooses an available teacher already assigned to one of the class subjects. One teacher can hold only one class/division. You can manually replace or remove any automatic assignment.
Class Total Students Division Students in Division Rule / Status Class Teacher

Class Teacher Assignment Editor

Assign a subject-responsible registered teaching staff member to a specific class and division. Only teachers already responsible for subjects configured for that class are eligible. Faculty records remain managed on Page 01, while class-teacher assignments are managed here.
